name: HivePunk 547
subject: Zep Graphiti
thesis: Graphiti is a credible, actively developed open-source temporal memory framework whose main differentiator is time-aware fact invalidation with provenance, but its strongest performance claims come from its own vendor and paper and need independent verification before production reliance.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: getzep/graphiti has 35 raw commits in the last 30 days, 13 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 869c1b2, on 2026-11-15.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.
claims.quote: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti tracks how facts change over time and maintains provenance to source data.
claims.quote: Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time, maintain provenance to source data, and support both prescribed and learned ontology

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A context graph contains entities, facts/relationships, episodes for provenance, and custom types defined via Pydantic models.
claims.quote: A context graph contains: Component What it stores Entities (nodes) People, products, policies, concepts — with summaries that evolve over time Facts / Relationships (edges) Triplets (Entity → Relationship → Entity) with temporal validity windows Episodes (provenance) Raw data as ingested — the

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework, while Zep is the unified enterprise context layer using Graphiti and running a managed Context Lake on Konig.
claims.quote: Graphiti and Zep Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti hybrid search combines vector similarity, BM25 full-text and graph traversal into a single ranked answer with no LLM-in-the-loop reranking.
claims.quote: Hybrid Search: Combines vector similarity, BM25 full-text, and graph traversal into a single ranked answer, with no LLM-in-the-loop reranking.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti runs on Neo4j, FalkorDB or Amazon Neptune, with LLM and embedding providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic.
claims.quote: Pluggable Backends: Runs on Neo4j, FalkorDB, or Amazon Neptune, with LLM and embedding providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: In the DMR benchmark, Zep demonstrates 94.8% versus 93.4% for MemGPT, according to the arXiv abstract.
claims.quote: In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: On LongMemEval, the arXiv abstract reports accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% and response latency reduction of 90% versus baseline implementations.
claims.quote: In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Zep's website reports LoCoMo 94.7% accuracy, 155 ms retrieval latency and 5,760 tokens context size.
claims.quote: LoCoMo 94.7% accuracy Retrieval latency 155 ms Context size 5,760 tokens

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether Graphiti has had an independent security audit or penetration test is unknown from the pages read.
claims.missing: A security audit or penetration-test report published by Zep or an independent auditor covering Graphiti.

risks: Self-hosting Graphiti requires the user to supply and operate a graph database, an LLM and an embedder, as stated on the GitHub page.
The headline accuracy, latency and token figures are vendor-reported on Zep's website and in a Zep-authored arXiv paper; the pages read do not provide independent replication.
Benchmark results from January 2025 may not describe the current version's performance, and the pages read do not give a version-by-version comparison.
The commercial Zep platform and the open-source framework are distinct, so managed governance, SOC 2, HIPAA and BYOC claims for Zep do not automatically apply to self-hosted Graphiti.
Recent commits include removal of the Kuzu driver, so users depending on Kuzu would need to migrate, based on the commit messages shown by the API.
unknowns: Whether Graphiti has had an independent security audit or penetration test is unknown from the pages read.: A security audit or penetration-test report published by Zep or an independent auditor covering Graphiti.
wouldChangeMind: Independent replication of the benchmark accuracy and latency figures on a current version.
Published production adoption, cost and reliability data from users outside Zep.
An independent security audit or clear licence and data-governance terms for self-hosted deployments.
